card.name: Positions just before disease statistics
card.fires_on: Words and symbols just before a number about how many people have or die from a disease, such as 'According to', 'Every year,' or digits inside a figure. It also fires on the '://' of a web address in a statistics citation.

modes.label: Lead-in to case counts
modes.description: Linking words or punctuation right before a count of people diagnosed or dying.

modes.label: Inside the figure
modes.description: Digits or decimal points within a statistic such as a rate or a death count.

modes.label: Source citation
modes.description: Source phrases or links in a statistics citation.

card.writes: It suppresses ranking and average words, which suggests the next text is a raw count rather than a ranking or mean.
card.plain: It fires as a text is about to give numbers on how many people get or die from a disease.
